findings.detail: Capture validation only checks 0 <= started <= received <= now. Responses recorded before the requested coverage window, or out of sequence across account/pages/account, are accepted and returned with pagination_exhausted=true and a fresh observed_ms. A stale/incorrect replay can therefore be labeled as evidence for an interval that had not existed when the HTTP data were captured. Fixed now_ms supports replay but must not remove source-time consistency. Require the requested until boundary to precede relevant captures and reject impossible sequential capture ordering; keep finality false.
findings.requested_fix: Validate coverage-to-capture and chronological request ordering; add focused stale-window and reversed-capture regressions.
findings.title: Bind the requested coverage end to the actual response times

findings.detail: All captures exist only in a local list returned on success. A later 503, bad JSON, duplicate/page bound, moved account or transport exception discards prior valid captures from the caller-visible result; non-200/raw-invalid responses are rejected before recording their raw evidence. The injected GET contract does not require independent durable persistence, so a source failure can erase the very cost/fee evidence needed to reconcile it. Fail closed without success/finality, but expose immutable bounded received captures and failing raw metadata through a structured failure or typed exception.
findings.requested_fix: Preserve every bounded received response, including the failed response where available, and carry partial captures on the failure path without issuing retries or financial writes.
findings.title: Preserve partial and rejected HTTP evidence on failure

scope: New collect_account_cost_source and its focused tests only; source evidence, no finality or release approval.
source_limit: Successful pagination is only HTTP source coverage and does not prove late fee completeness, settled allocations or all market events.
